import fcntl
import json
import pathlib
import statistics
import subprocess

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
cache = root / '.verify-helper/cache'
lock = open('/tmp/cp-wm-opt.lock', 'w')
flags = ['-std=c++23', '-O2', '-march=native']
fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
try:
    subprocess.run(['g++', *flags, '-I', str(root), str(cache / 'wm_rank_oct.cpp'), '-o', '/var/tmp/wm_rank_oct'], check=True)
finally:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
results = []
for n in (200000, 1000000):
    for mode in (0, 1, 2):
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        try:
            raw = subprocess.check_output(['taskset', '-c', '2', '/var/tmp/wm_rank_oct', str(n), str(mode)], text=True)
        finally:
            fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
        pairs = [line.split() for line in raw.splitlines()]
        item = {'n': n, 'mode': mode, 'ratio': statistics.median(float(p[1]) / float(p[2]) for p in pairs), 'pairs': pairs}
        print(json.dumps(item), flush=True)
        results.append(item)
        (cache / 'wm_rank_oct_results.json').write_text(json.dumps({'flags': flags, 'cases': results}, indent=2) + '\n')

import pathlib
import subprocess

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
base = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', '523956f:data_structure/wavelet_matrix.hpp'], cwd=root, text=True)
source = (root / '.verify-helper/cache/wm_rank_candidate.hpp').read_text()

def section(text, signature):
    start = text.index(signature)
    brace = text.index('{', start)
    depth = 1
    end = brace + 1
    while depth:
        depth += (text[end] == '{') - (text[end] == '}')
        end += 1
    return text[start:end]

source = source.replace('#include "components/oct_bit_vector.hpp"', '#include "components/oct_bit_vector.hpp"\n#include "components/quad_bit_vector.hpp"')
source = source.replace('\tbool vectorized = BitVector::has_avx2();', '\tbool vectorized = BitVector::has_avx2();\n\tmutable int sum_levels = 0;\n\tmutable std::vector<QuadBitVector> sum_bits;\n\tmutable std::vector<std::array<int, 4>> sum_middle;')
old = section(source, '\tvoid partition_sum(')
new = section(base, '\tvoid partition_sum(').replace('middle[d]', 'sum_middle[d]').replace('levels', 'sum_levels').replace('partition(current, next, d);', 'partition_for_sum(current, next, d);')
source = source.replace(old, new)
partition = section(base, '\tvoid partition(').replace('partition(', 'partition_for_sum(', 1).replace('middle[d]', 'sum_middle[d]').replace('levels', 'sum_levels')
source = source.replace('\ttemplate <class S>\n\tvoid partition_sum(', partition + '\n\ttemplate <class S>\n\tvoid partition_sum(', 1)
old = section(source, '\tvoid init_sum(')
new = section(base, '\tvoid init_sum(').replace('3 * levels + 1', '3 * sum_levels + 1')
new = new.replace('\t{\n', '\t{\n\t\tsum_levels = (std::bit_width(unsigned(static_cast<int>(values.size()) - 1)) + 1) / 2;\n', 1)
source = source.replace(old, new)
old = section(source, '\tvoid construct(')
new = old.replace('\t\tsum_prefix.clear();', '\t\tsum_bits.clear();\n\t\tsum_middle.clear();\n\t\tsum_levels = 0;\n\t\tsum_prefix.clear();', 1)
new = new.replace('''\t\tmiddle.resize(levels);
\t\tif constexpr (supports_sum)
\t\t\tif (with_sum) init_sum();
''', '\t\tmiddle.resize(levels);\n')
new = new.replace('''\t\t\tif constexpr (supports_sum) {
\t\t\t\tif (with_sum) {
\t\t\t\t\tif (narrow_sums) partition_sum(compact_prefix, current, next, d);
\t\t\t\t\telse partition_sum(sum_prefix, current, next, d);
\t\t\t\t} else if (d + 1 < levels) partition(current, next, d);
\t\t\t} else if (d + 1 < levels) partition(current, next, d);''', '\t\t\tif (d + 1 < levels) partition(current, next, d);')
assert 'partition_sum(' not in new
end = new.rindex('\t\tsum_ready = with_sum;')
new = new[:end] + new[end:].replace('\t\tsum_ready = with_sum;', '\t\tif constexpr (supports_sum)\n\t\t\tif (with_sum) prepare_sum();', 1)
source = source.replace(old, new)
old = section(source, '\tvoid prepare_sum(')
new = section(base, '\tvoid prepare_sum(')
start = new.index('\t\tif (narrow_sums)\n')
end = new.index('\t\tsum_ready = true;', start)
new = new[:start] + '''\t\tsum_bits.reserve(sum_levels);
\t\tsum_middle.resize(sum_levels);
\t\tfor (int d = 0; d < sum_levels; ++d) {
\t\t\tsum_bits.emplace_back(n);
\t\t\tsum_bits.back().build(current, 2 * (sum_levels - 1 - d));
\t\t\tauto totals = sum_bits.back().ranks(n);
\t\t\tsum_middle[d] = {0, totals[0], totals[0] + totals[1], totals[0] + totals[1] + totals[2]};
\t\t\tif (narrow_sums) partition_sum(compact_prefix, current, next, d);
\t\t\telse partition_sum(sum_prefix, current, next, d);
\t\t}
''' + new[end:]
source = source.replace(old, new)
route = section(base, '\t[[gnu::always_inline]] Route route(')
prefix = route[:route.index('\t\tif constexpr (ForSum) {')]
body_start = route.index('\t\tif constexpr (ForSum) {') + len('\t\tif constexpr (ForSum) {\n')
body_end = route.index('\n\t\t} else {', body_start)
route = (prefix + route[body_start:body_end] + '\n\t}').replace('Route route(', 'SumRoute sum_route(').replace('bits[d]', 'sum_bits[d]')
route = '\tstruct SumRoute {\n\t\tint digit, a, b, k, high_l, high_r, zero_l, zero_r;\n\t};\n' + route
source = source.replace('\tusing Route = typename BitVector::Route;', route + '\n\tusing Route = typename BitVector::Route;')
old = section(base, '\tS sum_smallest_impl(').replace('levels', 'sum_levels').replace('middle[d]', 'sum_middle[d]').replace('route<true>', 'sum_route')
scalar = old.replace('sum_smallest_impl(', 'sum_smallest_impl_scalar(', 1)
avx2 = old.replace('sum_smallest_impl(', 'sum_smallest_impl_avx2(', 1)
avx2 = '\t__attribute__((target("avx2,popcnt")))' + avx2[1:]
new = '\ttemplate <class S>\n' + scalar + '\n#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)\n\ttemplate <class S>\n' + avx2 + '\n#endif\n\ttemplate <class S>\n\tS sum_smallest_impl(const std::vector<std::vector<S>> &prefix, int l, int r, int k) const\n\t\trequires supports_sum\n\t{\n#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)\n\t\tif (vectorized) return sum_smallest_impl_avx2(prefix, l, r, k);\n#endif\n\t\treturn sum_smallest_impl_scalar(prefix, l, r, k);\n\t}'
start = source.index('\ttemplate <class S>\n\tS sum_smallest_impl_scalar(')
old = section(source, '\tS sum_smallest_impl(')
end = source.index(old) + len(old)
source = source[:start] + new + source[end:]
source = source.replace('\ttemplate <bool ForSum = false>\n\t[[gnu::always_inline]] Route route_scalar', '\t[[gnu::always_inline]] Route route_scalar')
source = source.replace('\ttemplate <bool ForSum = false>\n\t__attribute__((target("avx2,popcnt"), always_inline)) Route route_avx2', '\t__attribute__((target("avx2,popcnt"), always_inline)) Route route_avx2')
source = source.replace('bits[d].template route_scalar<ForSum>(l, r, k)', 'bits[d].route_scalar(l, r, k)')
source = source.replace('bits[d].template route_avx2<ForSum>(l, r, k)', 'bits[d].route_avx2(l, r, k)')
(root / '.verify-helper/cache/wm_rank_dual_candidate.hpp').write_text(source)
scripts.wm_rank_full.py:
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import statistics
import subprocess

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
cache = root / '.verify-helper/cache/wm_rank_full'
cache.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
candidate = root / os.environ.get('WM_HEADER', '.verify-helper/cache/wm_rank_candidate.hpp')
component = root / 'components/oct_bit_vector.hpp'
(cache / 'oct_bit_vector.hpp').write_bytes(component.read_bytes())
(cache / 'candidate.hpp').write_text(candidate.read_text().replace('components/oct_bit_vector.hpp', 'oct_bit_vector.hpp'))
old = root / '.verify-helper/cache/wm_rank_probe/ternary/before.hpp'
bench = (root / 'test/benchmark/wavelet_matrix_neighbors.cpp').read_text()
bench = f'#include "{old}"\n#include "candidate.hpp"\n' + bench[bench.index('#include <chrono>'):]
(cache / 'bench.cpp').write_text(bench)
flags = ['-std=c++23', '-O2']
native = not bool(os.environ.get('WM_GENERIC'))
if native:
    flags.append('-march=native')
lock = open('/tmp/cp-wm-opt.lock', 'w')
fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
try:
    subprocess.run(['g++', *flags, '-I', str(root), str(cache / 'bench.cpp'), '-o', '/var/tmp/wm_rank_full'], check=True)
finally:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
results = {'baseline': '523956f', 'flags': flags, 'compiler': subprocess.check_output(['g++', '--version'], text=True).splitlines()[0], 'candidate_sha256': hashlib.sha256(candidate.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'component_sha256': hashlib.sha256(component.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'cases': []}
cases = [(n, m, o) for n in (200000, 1000000) for m in (0, 1, 2) for o in (1, 2, 4, 7)]
cases += [(200000, m, o) for m in (6, 7, 8) for o in (1, 7, 8)]
cases += [(200000, 0, o) for o in (0, 12, 13)]
if os.environ.get('WM_QUICK'):
    cases = [(200000, m, o) for m in (0, 1) for o in (1, 2, 7)]
if os.environ.get('WM_SUM'):
    cases = [(200000, m, o) for m in (0, 1, 2, 6, 7, 8) for o in (7, 8)]
    cases += [(200000, 0, o) for o in (0, 12, 13)]
for n, mode, operation in cases:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
    try:
        raw = subprocess.check_output(['taskset', '-c', '2', '/var/tmp/wm_rank_full', str(n), str(mode), str(operation), '0', '0.06', '3', 'uniform'], text=True)
    finally:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
    pairs = {}
    for line in raw.splitlines():
        pair, variant, cpu, wall, checksum, reps = line.split()
        pairs.setdefault(pair, {})[variant] = {'cpu': float(cpu), 'wall': float(wall), 'checksum': checksum, 'repetitions': int(reps)}
    ratio = statistics.median(p['0']['cpu'] / p['1']['cpu'] for p in pairs.values())
    item = {'n': n, 'mode': mode, 'operation': operation, 'ratio': ratio, 'pairs': pairs}
    results['cases'].append(item)
    print(json.dumps(item), flush=True)
    (cache / os.environ.get('WM_OUTPUT', 'native.json' if native else 'generic.json')).write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2) + '\n')

import pathlib

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
source = (root / '.verify-helper/cache/wm_rank_candidate.hpp').read_text()
source = source.replace('\t__attribute__((target("avx2,popcnt")))', '#if defined(__AVX2__) && defined(__POPCNT__)\n\t[[gnu::always_inline]]\n#endif\n\t__attribute__((target("avx2,popcnt")))')
for name, args, spec in [('interval', 'l, r, x', ''), ('less_than', 'l, r, x', ''), ('neighbor', 'l, r, x', '<Previous>'), ('sum_smallest_impl', 'prefix, l, r, k', ''), ('kth', 'l, r, k', '')]:
    old = f'#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)\n\t\tif (vectorized) return {name}_avx2{spec}({args});'
    new = f'#if defined(__AVX2__) && defined(__POPCNT__)\n\t\treturn {name}_avx2{spec}({args});\n#elif defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)\n\t\tif (vectorized) return {name}_avx2{spec}({args});'
    assert old in source
    source = source.replace(old, new)
(root / '.verify-helper/cache/wm_rank_inline_candidate.hpp').write_text(source)
